sources.title: Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The 7B, 13B and 70B Code Llama and Code Llama - Instruct variants support infilling based on surrounding content. Code Llama reaches state-of-the-art performance among open models on several code benchmarks, with scores of up to 67% and 65% on HumanEval and MBPP, respectively.

sources.title: GitHub - inferless/codellama-7b: A 7B-parameter, Python-specialized ...
sources.snippet: Code Llama is a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned generative text models ranging in scale from 7 billion to 34 billion parameters. This is the repository for the 7B Python specialist version. This model is designed for general code synthesis and understanding.
